title: UniRec: Cross-stage Multi-Task Fusion with Preference Alignment for Cascaded Recommender Systems
summary:
Industrial recommender systems use cascaded stages with different objectives, feature spaces, and latency constraints. Optimizing pre-ranking and ranking separately can create cross-stage inconsistency: upstream models may filter out items preferred by downstream rankers, and independently tuned downstream fusion can offset upstream improvements. Existing multi-task fusion methods focus on multi-objective fusion within the ranking stage, and cross-stage methods typically only add a downstream score factor to upstream ranking. Joint optimization of fusion modules across both stages remains largely unexplored.
  We propose UniRec, a Unified Cross-stage Recommendation Fusion model. First, the two fusion agents partially share input embeddings and are trained in a single computation graph, so gradients from either stage propagate through the shared representation and influence the other. Second, we introduce a dual-axis preference alignment objective: a vertical cross-stage consistency term transfers downstream pairwise preferences to the upstream fusion score, and a horizontal compact aggregation term reorganizes dozens of pairwise objectives over heterogeneous prior signals into bidirectional preference evidence. Third, we find that unconstrained end-to-end fusion optimization can exploit imbalances in item attribute distributions, over-concentrating on high-reward regions at the cost of other objectives. We therefore add an attribute group-relative regularization that computes advantages within attribute groups and normalizes the policy over the same groups, so uniformly promoting an entire high-reward group yields no optimization gain. Offline, UniRec consistently outperforms single-stage fusion and cross-stage coordination baselines. Online A/B tests show a 0.616\% gain in app usage duration. UniRec is fully deployed on the Kuaishou platform.

AI.tldr: UniRec 提出跨阶段统一推荐融合模型，通过共享嵌入、双轴偏好对齐与属性组相对正则，联合优化预排序与排序阶段的融合模块，并在快手全量部署。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统采用级联阶段，各阶段目标、特征空间与时延约束不同，独立优化预排序与排序会造成跨阶段不一致：上游可能过滤掉下游偏好的物品，下游独立调参的融合又会抵消上游收益。已有工作多聚焦排序阶段内的多目标融合，跨阶段方法通常只在上游加入下游分数因子，跨阶段融合模块的联合优化仍属空白。
AI.method: 作者提出 UniRec：(1) 两个融合 agent 部分共享输入嵌入并在同一计算图中训练，使任一阶段梯度都经过共享表示影响另一阶段；(2) 双轴偏好对齐目标——纵向跨阶段一致性项将下游成对偏好传递给上游融合分数，横向紧凑聚合项将大量异构先验信号上的成对目标重组为双向偏好证据；(3) 针对端到端融合优化会利用物品属性分布不均衡、过度集中于高收益区域的问题，引入属性组相对正则，在属性组内计算优势并在同组内归一化策略，使整体提升高收益组不产生优化增益。
AI.result: 离线实验中 UniRec 稳定优于单阶段融合与跨阶段协调基线；在线 A/B 测试显示应用使用时长提升 0.616%，且已在快手平台全量部署。
AI.conclusion: 跨阶段联合优化融合模块可缓解级联推荐中的阶段不一致问题，兼具离线与线上收益，并具备大规模工业落地的可行性。
AI.reason: 面向工业级级联推荐（预排序—排序）的跨阶段多目标任务融合，动机清晰、方法有创新性，含离线对比与快手线上 A/B 及全量部署验证。

title: FedHUR: Learning Hierarchical Utility-Guided Client Relations for Personalized Federated Recommendation
summary: Federated recommendation enables collaborative model training while keeping user interaction data on local clients. A central problem in federated recommendation is how to aggregate useful information across clients for personalized recommendation. Existing personalized aggregation methods usually construct client relations from predefined parameter-based assumptions, such as parameter similarity or complementarity, and use these relations to determine aggregation weights. However, such methods construct a single global relation, which is insufficient to capture the hierarchical and multi-granularity nature of user relations in recommendation. Moreover, these predefined relations cannot directly reflect whether the related clients can improve prediction performance after aggregation. To address these limitations, we propose FedHUR, a federated recommendation framework for learning hierarchical utility-guided client relations. FedHUR takes item-item filters as the object for relation construction and aggregation. Specifically, it first aggregates and clusters each client's local information to obtain global hierarchical information. Each client computes hierarchical utility signals based on its local information and the global hierarchical information, indicating which collaborative information is useful for improving its prediction. The server uses these utility signals to retrieve clients that are useful to that client for further personalized aggregation. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets show that FedHUR consistently outperforms existing federated recommendation baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical utility-guided client relation learning. Code is available at https://github.com/Mingzhe-Han/FedHUR.

AI.tldr: FedHUR：以 item-item 过滤器为关系载体、用分层效用信号指导客户端检索与个性化聚合的联邦推荐框架。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦推荐个性化聚合方法依赖参数相似性/互补性等预定义假设来构建客户端关系，只能得到单一全局关系，难以刻画用户关系的层次性与多粒度特性，且预定义关系无法直接反映聚合后是否真的提升预测性能。
AI.method: 以 item-item filters 为关系构建与聚合对象：先对客户端局部信息进行聚合与聚类以获得全局分层信息；每个客户端基于本地信息与全局分层信息计算分层效用信号，指示哪些协作信息对提升其预测有用；服务器据此检索对目标客户端有用的客户端，进行个性化聚合。
AI.result: 在五个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，FedHUR 一致优于现有的联邦推荐基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 分层效用引导的客户端关系学习能有效提升联邦推荐的个性化聚合效果，验证了该框架的有效性，代码已开源。
AI.reason: 核心主题为联邦推荐中的个性化聚合，属于推荐系统研究；方法以效用信号替代预定义假设具有新意，五个数据集实验较充分，故给予较高优先级。

title: Reification as a Transferable Vocabulary: Zero-Shot Link Prediction with Vanilla GNNs
summary: Knowledge graph foundation models such as ULTRA achieve zero-shot link prediction on unseen graphs through dedicated architectures that hard-code a transfer mechanism. In this work we move that mechanism out of the architecture and into the representation, by \emph{reifying} the input graph: every fact becomes a node, connected to its subject, object, and relation type through a fixed vocabulary of six meta-relations, with relation types as anonymous shared nodes rather than model parameters. On this representation, five textbook GNNs (GAT, GINE with sum and with mean+max aggregation, GraphSAGE, R-GCN), each trained on a single knowledge graph of 4,245 triples for 30 minutes on one NVIDIA A100, transfer zero-shot to 40 inductive link-prediction benchmarks. The best of them, an off-the-shelf GAT, matches ULTRA, a dedicated foundation model pretrained on three graphs, across ULTRA's own evaluation suite. The same fixed vocabulary extends to relational databases, a row becoming an entity and a foreign-key column a relation type; a preliminary probe on two unseen databases, with no cell values, schema text or in-context labels, shows a model of this family pretrained on three knowledge graphs ranking foreign-key targets far above random-initialization and degree controls. We release the code, the checkpoints, and the evaluation pipeline for all 40 benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"具体化"(reification)输入图——将每个事实变成节点，用固定六种元关系连接主语、宾语与关系类型——使普通GNN可在零样本归纳式链接预测上媲美专用知识图谱基础模型ULTRA，并将同一表示扩展到关系数据库外键预测。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱基础模型（如ULTRA）依赖把迁移机制硬编码进专用架构，泛化性与通用性受限。作者希望把迁移机制从架构转移到表示本身，从而用现成GNN实现跨图零样本迁移。
AI.method: 将知识图谱三元组具体化为节点，通过固定词汇表的六种元关系连向主语、宾语和匿名共享的关系类型节点；在该表示上用五种教科书级GNN（GAT、GINE-sum、GINE-mean+max、GraphSAGE、R-GCN），仅在单个含4,245条三元组的图上训练30分钟（单张A100），随后零样本迁移到40个归纳式链接预测基准；同一词汇表扩展到关系数据库（行=实体，外键列=关系类型）。
AI.result: 最佳模型（现成GAT）在ULTRA自身的评测套件上与其持平；在40个归纳式基准上实现零样本迁移。数据库初步探测中，模型在无单元格值、无schema文本、无上下文标签条件下，将外键目标排序显著优于随机初始化与度控制基线。
AI.conclusion: 把迁移机制从架构移入表示，是一条更简单、更通用且有效的路径，可统一处理知识图谱与关系数据库；作者开源代码、检查点及全部40个基准的评测流程。
AI.reason: 与推荐系统常用的知识图谱/链接预测直接相关，方法新颖、实验扎实且开放资源，但作者隶属机构不详。

title: On the Regularization Landscape for the Linear Recommendation Models
summary: Recently, a wide range of recommendation algorithms inspired by deep learning techniques have emerged as the performance leaders on several standard recommendation benchmarks. While these algorithms were built on different DL techniques (e.g., dropouts, autoencoder), they have similar performance and even similar cost functions. This paper studies whether the models' comparable performance are sheer coincidence, or they can be unified under a single framework. We find that all linear performance leaders effectively add only a nuclear-norm based regularizer, or a Frobenius-norm based regularizer. The former ones possess a (surprising) rigid structure that limits the models' predictive power but their solutions are low rank and have closed form. The latter ones are more expressive and more efficient for recommendation but their solutions are either full-rank or require executing hard-to-tune numeric procedures such as ADMM. Along this line of finding, we further propose two low-rank, closed-form solutions, derived from carefully generalizing Frobenius-norm based regularizers. The new solutions get the best of both nuclear-norm and Frobenius-norm world.

AI.tldr: 本文统一分析线性深度推荐模型的正则化本质：性能领先者实际只是在目标中加入核范数或Frobenius范数正则，并据此提出两种闭式、低秩的新解法，兼具两类正则的优点。
AI.motivation: 深度推荐算法（dropout、autoencoder等）在标准基准上性能相近、代价函数也相似，作者希望探究这种性能可比性是巧合还是可统一到一个框架下，并借此改进模型表达能力与求解效率。
AI.method: 对若干线性性能领先模型进行理论剖析，证明其等价于引入核范数正则或Frobenius范数正则；分析核范数解的刚性结构、低秩与闭式特性，以及Frobenius范数解的高表达力但满秩或需ADMM等难调数值求解的问题；随后对Frobenius范数正则进行推广，推导出两种低秩、闭式解。
AI.result: 核范数类模型解低秩且闭式但预测能力受限、结构僵化；Frobenius范数类更具表达力且推荐效率更高，但解为满秩或需ADMM等难调过程；新提出的两种低秩闭式解同时取得两类方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: 看似多样的线性深度推荐模型可统一为正则化视角下的两类方法，该统一视角既解释了性能相近的现象，也指导出更优的闭式低秩方案。
AI.reason: 主题为推荐系统模型的理论统一与正则化改进，方法分析有原创性；作者未显示知名机构归属，故影响力评分居中偏上。

title: Learnware and AI Model Management System
summary: The transition from file storage to database management systems transformed stored data into managed resources. AI now faces an analogous transition from AI model storage to AI model management. Existing model pools essentially serve as \textit{AI model storage systems}. What is needed instead are \textit{AI model management systems} that enable models trained by different developers, for different tasks, with different data, and under different objectives to be identified, reused, and even assembled to address future user tasks. Because AI model developers are generally unwilling to share their training data, such systems should operate without accessing the training data of model developers and, ideally, without accessing raw data of future users. This requirement poses a fundamental challenge: the functionality of a modern AI model may not be fully understood even by the developer who trained it. How, then, can a system identify which models are useful for a given user task, let alone assemble models developed independently for different purposes? At first glance, this objective may appear unattainable. It becomes possible, however, by upgrading the basic unit of management from a machine learning model to a \textit{learnware}. \textit{Learnware = Model + Specification}. The specification, whose assignment transforms a trained model into a learnware, is generated with the help of a machine learning process without disclosing the training data of the developer and has a theoretically established data-preservation property. The \textit{Learnware Dock System (LDS)} provides a path toward powerful AI model management systems. Because specifications are generated according to a published reference and are comparable across models, they can also serve as an AI model \textit{collaboration protocol} through which independently developed models, including intelligent agents, can collaborate.

AI.tldr: 该文是立场/展望型论文，主张AI领域正经历从"模型存储"到"模型管理"的转变，提出以"学件（Learnware = 模型 + 规约）"作为管理基本单元，并给出学件船坞系统（LDS）作为实现路径。
AI.motivation: 现有模型池只是"AI模型存储系统"，无法在开发者不愿共享训练数据、用户也不希望暴露原始数据的前提下，识别、复用乃至组装不同来源、不同任务、不同目标的模型；且现代模型的功能连开发者自身都难以完全理解，因此需要一个不访问训练数据仍能刻画模型可重用性的机制。
AI.method: 将管理基本单元从"机器学习模型"升级为"学件"：Learnware = Model + Specification。规约由机器学习过程在不披露开发者训练数据的情况下生成，具有理论上可证明的数据保持（data-preservation）性质；由于规约按公开参考标准生成，跨模型可比较，因此既可用于在船坞中检索/复用/组装模型，又可充当AI模型协作协议，使独立开发的模型（含智能体）得以协作。
AI.result: 文章主要为概念论证与体系设计，非实验性工作：论证了"看似不可达"的目标在学件范式下是可实现的，指出基于规约的可比性是可行性的关键，并说明LDS是从存储走向管理的实现路径。
AI.conclusion: AI需要与数据库管理系统诞生类似的范式跃迁：从模型存储走向模型管理。以学件为基本单元、以规约可比性为协作协议、以LDS为载体的体系，有望支撑模型的识别、复用、组装与跨模型协作，同时不触及开发者和用户的原始数据。
AI.reason: 属学件/模型管理的立场展望型工作，与推荐系统中的模型检索与复用直接相关但非典型推荐任务；作者周志华为南京大学知名学者，构想新颖有理论支撑，值得关注，但缺少实验评估。

title: Grounding Agent Memory: Environment-Probing Curation for Enterprise Agents
summary: Persistent memory is entering production-oriented agent platforms to help long-horizon agents accumulate experience across sessions. Yet a post-task curator agent restricted to completed trajectories can preserve errors, overgeneralize partial evidence, or retain stale knowledge. We introduce environment-probing curation, a deployment-compatible extension that gives an existing asynchronous curator agent least-privilege, read-only world tools to check, scope, and refresh candidate memories. It requires no model retraining and leaves the task agent, retriever, memory representation, and production write authority unchanged. In a production-like GitHub Copilot (GHCP) harness built on its SDK, we compare stateless execution, full in-context learning, GHCP + Mem, and GHCP + Mem (w/ Env Probing) on CLBench database exploration and 90 adapted APEX management-consulting tasks. On CLBench, probing raises pass rate from 39% to 73% and pass-discounted reward from 8.60 to 22.60 while reducing queries from 8.8 to 4.7 per question and task-agent cost from \$3.38 to \$1.68. Across six APEX worlds, all 18 memory-versus-baseline mean reward comparisons are positive and task-agent tool calls fall by 16--75%; probing gives the best task-agent reward gain per dollar in five worlds. Probing also attains higher mean reward than GHCP + Mem on both Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7 without schema drift. Environment probing therefore turns existing agent-memory curation into an environment-informed, auditable process while preserving a compact task-time interface.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"环境探测式记忆管理"（environment-probing curation）：为已有的异步记忆整理 agent 赋予只读的世界工具，用于校验、限定范围与刷新候选记忆，在 GitHub Copilot 生产级测试环境中显著提升任务表现并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的 agent 平台引入持久化记忆以跨会话积累经验，但仅基于已完成轨迹的事后整理 agent 会固化错误、过度泛化局部证据或保留过时知识。作者希望在无需重训练、不改动任务 agent/检索器/记忆表示与写入权限的前提下缓解该问题。
AI.method: 为现有异步 curator agent 增加最小权限、只读的环境（world）工具，使其在整理候选记忆时能够主动探测环境进行核实、限定作用域并刷新内容；方法作为部署兼容的扩展，不改变任务 agent、检索器、记忆表示及生产写入权。
AI.result: 在基于 GHCP SDK 的生产式 harness 上对比 stateless、full in-context learning、GHCP+Mem、GHCP+Mem（含环境探测）：CLBench 上通过率 39%→73%，通过折现奖励 8.60→22.60，单题查询数 8.8→4.7，任务 agent 成本 \$3.38→\$1.68；六个 APEX 世界中 18 组记忆 vs 基线平均奖励对比全部为正，任务 agent 工具调用下降 16–75%，五个世界中探测取得最佳"每美元奖励增益"；在 Sonnet 4.6 与 Opus 4.7 上均优于 GHCP+Mem 且无 schema 漂移。
AI.conclusion: 环境探测把已有的 agent 记忆整理转变为环境知情且可审计的过程，同时保持紧凑的任务时接口，无需重训练即可在生产平台落地。
AI.reason: 属于 LLM agent 的记忆/经验管理范畴，与推荐系统中的用户长期记忆与个性化经验复用思路相通，但非核心推荐任务；实验扎实（生产式 harness、多基线、多模型、成本指标），且作者来自 GitHub Copilot 团队，故给予较高优先级。
